notes.title: v.12 Released
notes.content:
Hey guys!  

Some great things in v.12:

Added player profiles, with saved names, colors and control styles!
Remap the buttons to anything you'd like!
Removed some weapons that were not performing well over the net. 
A few graphics tweaks and simplification of the menus.

Coming soon:
New game mode! (Race)
New Map! (It's awesome)
Tighter netcode and steering ability!
Keyboard and Mouse support!

Please submit bugs here or visit the Twitch channel to join the discussion:
http://twitch.tv/arconyx

notes.title: Version .11 Update
notes.content:
Added:
[list]
[*] Ability to choose between Arcade and Free controls.  Free changes the left stick to a steering wheel, with the directions always being relative to the car.  Arcade is still "headless" mode.  Free also makes RT accel and LT reverse.  As you might be aware, having to remap the face buttons to the other functions would make aiming the turret and firing with your right thumb impossible.  So, fire is X and Alt-Fire is Right Trigger button.  Try it out and let me know what you think.
[*] Local games behave like private lobbies with no countdown timer to ready up.
[/list]
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Sound issue on the menu
[*] Bug preventing local games from starting
[*] Bug preventing exiting a game after you had previously exited a game
[*] Bug preventing the options menu from loading in a lobby
[/list]

The ability to remap controls is very important, and will probably show up next, along with passworded private lobbies, followed by the race game mode and the new map.  Player profiles is important but is not game breaking right now.  

Please give feedback!

notes.title: v.09 and v.10 uploaded!
notes.content:
v.10
[list]
[*]Fixed issue making it impossible to back out of local play if 2 controllers are not plugged in
[*]Fixed round end music volume issue
[*]Fixed ctf flags spawning multiple times if you are frozen while carrying a flag
[*]Fixed flamethrower sound not stopping if a net player ran out of ammo or [*]picked up another weapon
[*]There is no longer a countdown in private lobbies when two or more players join, only public lobbies
[/list]

v.09
[list]
[*]Fixed CTF mode
[/list]

As always, the feedback from players is really important.  Please add yourself to the game community and find others who are playing to do some multiplayer combat!  My favorite is 2v2 CTF, it's just about the most fun you can have as a human. 

Also, remember we're live every weekday at twitch.tv/arconyx.  Please come by the channel and engage in the development!
